definitions.explanation: The act of transporting and delivering goods.

examples.japanese: {配送|はいそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
{配送|はいそう}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can specify the delivery date.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{配送|はいそう}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{配送|はいそう} refers to the process of transporting and delivering goods to a destination. Combines {配|はい} (distribute) + {送|そう} (send).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {配送|はいそう}⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (delivery fee)
- {配送|はいそう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (delivery destination)
- {配送|はいそう}⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (delivery status)
- {配送|はいそう}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧ (delivery date)
- ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧{配送|はいそう} (same-day delivery)
- ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧{配送|はいそう} (free shipping)
- {配送|はいそう}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (delivery company)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧: delivery (last-mile, to the recipient — e.g., mail, pizza)
- ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧: shipping/dispatch (from the sender's side)
- ⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧: shipment (business/warehouse term)
- ⟦{宅配|たくはい}→宅配：09571_takuhai⟧: home delivery (e.g., ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧)

USAGE:
Very common in online shopping contexts. {配送|はいそう} covers the whole delivery process from warehouse to customer.
